meta.notes: Upcoming, dated family events kept separate from map pins. Confirm times, access, and weather with the linked organizer before heading out.

events.title: Lakewood Cider Days
events.time: Sat 10:00 AM–5:00 PM · Sun 10:00 AM–4:00 PM

events.title: Pumpkin Fest
events.place: Fairmount Park, Golden
events.note: Free pancakes, games, live music, and fall fun; no reservation listed.

events.title: Boo at the Zoo

events.note: Remaining nights Oct 9–11, 16–18, 23–25, 30; Oct 31 is the sensory-friendly night. Nine candy stations, friendly cryptid characters, Wild Fall Market. Kids 2 and under free ($5 optional Lil' Boo Bag); adult $25.95 value nights (Oct 9–11), $27.95 later. Popular nights sell out. Early arrival suits nap/bedtime.

events.title: SCFD Free Day at the Forney Museum
events.place: Forney Museum of Transportation

events.source: Forney Museum / Days.in.denver

events.title: 2nd Saturday at CSU Spur: Día de los Muertos
events.place: CSU Spur, Denver

events.source: CSU Spur

events.title: Fall Festival at Giggling Life Care Farm

events.title: Free admission day: Fire Safety & Prevention Week

events.title: SCFD Free Day: OUT! at the Museum

events.source: Denver Museum of Nature & Science / Days.in.denver

events.title: Spooky Sweets Stroll
events.place: Orchard Town Center, 14697 Delaware St, Westminster
events.note: Free, no RSVP. Trick-or-treat at 50+ shops, free face painting and games, live DJ; pumpkin decorating for a $5–$10 donation (Food for Hope).
events.source: Colorado Mama Life (IG Oct 7, NORTH edition); theorchardtowncenter.com

events.title: Trunk-or-Treat + Outdoor Movie: Monsters vs. Aliens
events.place: Infinity Park, Glendale
events.note: Free family evening; bring blankets or lawn chairs. Trunk-or-treat starts at gate opening.
events.source: Infinity Park at Glendale

events.title: Harvest Haunt Express
events.place: Colorado Railroad Museum, Golden
events.note: Halloween weekend at the train museum. Check the museum site for tickets and train times.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life (IG Oct 8 Halloween list); coloradorailroadmuseum.org

events.title: Mines Museum Spooktacular
events.place: Mines Museum of Earth Science, Golden
events.note: Free teal-pumpkin trick-or-treat with STEM activities, prizes, face painting, and spooky exhibits.
events.source: Mines Museum / Visit Golden

events.title: Puppies & Pumpkins
events.place: Steinbaugh Pavilion, 824 Front St, Louisville
events.note: Family fall puppy-adoption event with pumpkins and activities (Soul Dog Rescue). Confirm details with the organizer.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life (IG Oct 8 Halloween list); web listing

events.title: Safe Street Halloween
events.place: E.M. Wyatt Centennial Park, 301 Kennedy Dr, Northglenn
events.note: Free Northglenn Police event: trick-or-treat street on Kennedy Dr with inflatables, music, and trunk-or-treat cars; Haunted Mansion theme. Outdoors and busy (about 5,000 kids), so plan time to park at Northglenn Marketplace.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life (IG Oct 7, NORTH edition); northglenn.org

events.title: Westy Fest
events.place: Westminster City Park, 10455 N Sheridan Blvd
events.note: Free fall festival with carnival games, trick-or-treating, live music, pumpkin patch, and hot-air-balloon glow; parking is limited, so use a shuttle if possible.
events.source: City of Westminster

events.title: Harvest Hoot
events.place: Children's Museum of Denver, 2121 Children's Museum Dr
events.note: Costumes welcome; Monster Mash Circus, sensory sand potions, carnival games, cranberry bog. Included with admission (members free); tickets day-of only. No trick-or-treating.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life (IG Oct 8 Halloween list); Colorado Parent / museum listing

events.title: SCFD Free Admission Day at Four Mile
events.place: Four Mile Historic Park
events.note: Free admission to the historic farm park. Days.in.denver flagged that the date in her reel was wrong; the caption and Four Mile’s calendar both say Oct 23.
events.source: Four Mile Historic Park / Days.in.denver

events.title: BOOmar at Belmar
events.place: The Plaza at Belmar, 439 S Upham St, Lakewood
events.note: Free: face painting, balloon twisting, crafts, costume parade, trick-or-treating at Belmar shops.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life; belmarcolorado.com

events.title: Crawl-O-Ween at Butterfly Pavilion
events.place: Butterfly Pavilion, Westminster
events.note: Indoor costume trick-or-treating with candy and toy stations. Also Oct 31. Adults $25, kids 2–12 $19, under 2 free.
events.source: Colorado Kids Explore; butterflies.org

events.title: Trick or Treat Street at Larimer Square
events.place: Larimer Square, Denver
events.note: Free; candy from participating businesses, costume contest, fall activities, photo booth.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life (IG Oct 8 Halloween list); larimersquare.com

events.title: Halloween Boo and Bounce
events.place: tumble HAUS, 1330 W 38th Ave, Denver
events.note: Halloween party at the Highlands indoor play space for babies and toddlers; book through the site.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life (IG Oct 8 Halloween list, as 'Tumble HAUS Halloween Bash'); tumblehaus.com

events.title: BOOnion Station
events.place: Denver Union Station, 1701 Wynkoop St
events.note: Free: mini train on the North Plaza, face painting, DJ, costume contest, trick-or-treating at station businesses.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life; denverunionstation.com

events.title: Trick-or-Treat Street
events.place: Denver Public Library Central Library
events.note: Free indoor trick-or-treating with candy and non-candy treats plus activities on each floor; no registration listed.
events.source: Denver Public Library / Days.in.denver

events.title: Hyland Hills Halloween Spooktacular
events.place: Adventure Golf & Raceway, 9650 Sheridan Blvd, Westminster
events.note: Free, ages 12 and under: trick-or-treat stations along three mini-golf courses. Evening, so best right after dinner.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life (IG Oct 7, NORTH edition); hylandhills.org

events.title: Olde Town Trick or Treat Street
events.place: Olde Town Arvada
events.note: Family trick-or-treating along Olde Town; Friday before Halloween.
events.source: Olde Town Arvada

events.title: Crawl-O-Ween at Butterfly Pavilion (Halloween)
events.place: Butterfly Pavilion, Westminster
events.note: Halloween-day session of the indoor trick-or-treat. Under 2 free.
events.source: Colorado Kids Explore; butterflies.org

events.title: Monster Mash
events.time: Afternoon; confirm time (Colorado Mama Life lists 2–4 PM)
events.place: Golden History Museum & Park, 923 10th St, Golden
events.note: Free drop-in Halloween party with crafts, stories, and trick-or-treating around downtown Golden spots.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life; goldenhistory.org

events.title: DreamLab Opening Day at Longmont Museum
events.place: Longmont Museum, 400 Quail Rd, Longmont
events.note: Free grand reopening; DreamLab permanent children's gallery opens. After Oct 17, regular museum admission (~$12 adults / $5 children).
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Oct 12; City of Longmont

events.title: Highlands Harvest Festival & Trick-or-Treat Street
events.place: W 32nd Ave between Julian St and Newton St, Denver Highlands
events.note: Free costume contest, pumpkin patch, jump castle, kids' games, live music, beer garden, trick-or-treating at neighborhood businesses. From Days.in.denver Fall guide; confirmed on Highland Square site.
events.source: Days.in.denver Fall 2026 guide; visitdenverhighlands.com

events.title: Haunted Trail Adventure
events.place: Bear Creek Lake Park, 15600 W Morrison Rd, Lakewood
events.note: Owl Trail stories/critters, carnival games, treats, then amphitheater s'mores & hot chocolate. Advance registration required (no walk-ins). From Days.in.denver Fall guide; confirmed on City of Lakewood.
events.source: Days.in.denver Fall 2026 guide; lakewoodco.gov

events.title: Magic of the Jack O'Lanterns
events.time: Evening ticketed entry (times vary by date); daytime garden free / unlit
events.place: Hudson Gardens, 6115 S Santa Fe Dr, Littleton
events.note: Nighttime carved-pumpkin walk, ticketed, through Nov 1. Daytime garden stroll free (displays not lit). Gardens close 4:30 PM on event nights (CKAR). Confirm nightly schedule/tickets on Hudson Gardens.
events.source: Colorado Kids Are Rad + Colorado Kids Explore IG Oct 12; Days.in.denver Fall guide

events.title: Howl-o-ween at The Golden Mill
events.place: The Golden Mill, 1012 Ford St, Golden
events.note: 5th annual costume afternoon for dogs, kids, and families: pet parade, live music (Wild Goose Chase), adoptable dogs, and a best kid costume prize. Free to attend; food hall purchases extra (18% service fee).
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Oct 16 free Halloween weekend list; confirmed on thegoldenmill.com and visitgolden.com

events.title: Market in the Park-et Halloween Spook-tacular
events.place: Washington Park Boathouse, 701 S Franklin St, Denver
events.note: Free all-ages outdoor market with 70+ local vendors, food trucks, and DJs; costumes encouraged. More of a stroller wander than a kid activity, but the park and lake are right there. Free parking per organizer.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Oct 16 free Halloween weekend list; confirmed on marketintheparket.com and Eventbrite

events.title: Trunk-or-Treat at Golden Corral Thornton
events.place: Golden Corral, 9751 Grant St, Thornton, CO 80229
events.note: Free trunk-or-treat in the restaurant parking lot. Time comes from Colorado Mama Life's list; the restaurant's own posts mention the Oct 17 date but no time was found on an organizer page, so confirm before going.
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Oct 16 free Halloween weekend list

events.title: Mythic Creatures: Dragons, Unicorns & Mermaids at DMNS
events.time: Museum hours 9 AM–5 PM daily (most Fridays to 9 PM)
events.place: Denver Museum of Nature & Science, 2001 Colorado Blvd, Denver
events.note: New temporary exhibit included with general admission (free for members), with a mythical-creature dress-up area. Pair with the Nature Play park out back.
events.source: Days.in.denver IG Oct 16 reel; dmns.org

events.title: Skynets Over Downtown floating ribbon art (final weeks)
events.place: Skyline Park (1127 17th St) and Glenarm Plaza (500 16th St), Denver
events.note: Free floating ribbon canopies that ripple in the wind: Skyline Drift at Skyline Park and Quaking Gold at Glenarm Plaza, on view through Nov 8 (the Union Station piece already came down). Fun stroller stop for a toddler who likes looking up.
events.source: Little Rad Adventure IG Oct 17 reel; Denver Arts & Venues

events.title: Halloween Paint + Potions at Space DNVR
events.place: Space DNVR, 3810 Pierce St, Suite C, Wheat Ridge
events.note: Black-light glow paint on the walls, a take-home sensory potion station, and glow face painting. For kids of all ages plus parents; $50 for one parent + one child, $10 per extra family member 2 and up. Tickets are limited. Glow paint is harder to wash out of costumes.
events.source: Colorado Kids Are Rad IG Oct 19 reel (Space DNVR); spacednvr.com

events.title: Freaky Friday Fright Night Flicks: Toy Story of Terror!
events.place: Little Man Ice Cream LoHi, back amphitheatre, 2620 16th St, Denver
events.source: Days.in.denver IG Oct 22 post (https://www.instagram.com/p/DezQS1jB3Do/); Little Man Ice Cream Eventbrite
events.note: Free outdoor Halloween movie night with free popcorn, no tickets needed. Tonight's short is Toy Story of Terror! before The Addams Family (the feature is more for older kids). Starts at 7pm, past a toddler bedtime, and it's outside, so bring coats and blankets.

events.title: Freaky Friday Fright Night Flicks: Room on the Broom
events.place: Little Man Ice Cream LoHi, back amphitheatre, 2620 16th St, Denver
events.source: Days.in.denver IG Oct 22 post (https://www.instagram.com/p/DezQS1jB3Do/); Little Man Ice Cream Eventbrite
events.note: Free outdoor Halloween movie night with free popcorn, no tickets needed. The opening short is Room on the Broom, a great toddler pick, before Hocus Pocus (better to leave after the short). Starts at 7pm and it's outside, so bring coats and blankets.

events.title: Halloween Parade at Lakewood Library
events.place: Lakewood Library, 10200 W 20th Ave, Lakewood
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Oct 26 Halloween week post (https://www.instagram.com/p/De-mL9eT0Rf/); Jefferson County Public Library
events.note: Free costume parade and trick-or-treat walk around the library, listed for babies, toddlers, and preschoolers. Toddler Time runs at 10:15 the same morning.

events.title: Denver Zoo Community Free Day
events.time: Timed entry; free tickets released online Oct 28
events.place: Denver Zoo, 2300 Steele St, Denver
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Oct 27 free November list (https://www.instagram.com/p/DfBUIK2z1Gi/); denverzoo.org
events.note: Free, but online tickets only, first-come first-served, no walk-ups. Everyone needs a timed ticket, babies included; up to 5 per registration. Tickets went live Oct 28 and can go fast.

events.title: Denver Zoo Community Free Day (Saturday)
events.time: Timed entry; free tickets released online Oct 31
events.place: Denver Zoo, 2300 Steele St, Denver
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Oct 27 free November list (https://www.instagram.com/p/DfBUIK2z1Gi/); denverzoo.org
events.note: Free, but online tickets only, released Sat Oct 31 (around 9am per Mile High on the Cheap). Everyone needs a timed ticket, babies included; up to 5 per registration. Another free day is Sun Nov 22 (tickets Nov 8).

events.title: SCFD Free Day at Dinosaur Ridge
events.place: Dinosaur Ridge Main Visitor Center, 16831 W Alameda Pkwy, Morrison
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Oct 27 free November list (https://www.instagram.com/p/DfBUIK2z1Gi/); dinoridge.org
events.note: Free entry to the visitor center Exhibit Hall and the Deep Time Detour exhibit, plus $5 off guided bus tours. Indoor and outdoor, good for a dinosaur-loving toddler.

events.title: SCFD Free Day at the Museum of Nature & Science
events.place: Denver Museum of Nature & Science
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Oct 27 free November list (https://www.instagram.com/p/DfBUIK2z1Gi/); dmns.org
events.note: Free general admission, no tickets needed; walk up. Planetarium, theater, and temporary exhibits cost extra. It's a Monday, so likely calmer than a weekend free day. There's also a free evening Sat Nov 7, 5–10pm.

events.title: Georgetown Christmas Market
events.place: Historic 6th Street, Georgetown
events.drive_note: ~55 min from the 64th & Ward base (farther than 30 min)
events.source: Little Rad Adventure IG Oct 28 Georgetown post (https://www.instagram.com/p/DfCgeiTJVln/); Historic Georgetown, Inc.
events.note: Free admission, parking, and shuttle. Victorian carolers, roasted chestnuts, horse-drawn wagon rides, and Saint Nicholas. Two weekends only; it's a mountain town in December, so dress warm and check I-70 conditions.

events.title: Trunk-or-Treat at Indiana Business Park
events.place: Indiana Business Park, 14701 W 65th Way, Arvada, CO 80004
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Oct 29 Halloween plans post (https://www.instagram.com/p/DfFdku4zD3s/); Eventbrite listing by Fade It Golf and Social Club
events.note: Free. Costumes, candy, local businesses, MaMa D's Deli, and a treat at Fade It. Free Eventbrite registration listed.

events.title: Spooky Bizness at Little Monkey Bizness Parker
events.time: Sessions at 9:30 AM and 11:00 AM (90 min)
events.place: Little Monkey Bizness, 10430 S Progress Way, Parker, CO
events.drive_note: ~48 min from the 64th & Ward base (farther than 30 min)
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Oct 29 Halloween plans post (https://www.instagram.com/p/DfFdku4zD3s/)
events.note: $19 per child, up to 2 adults free per reservation. Indoor play, cookie decorating, a Halloween craft, scavenger hunt, costume contest, and a treat bag. Advance reservations required for every guest; bring socks.

events.title: National STEAM Day at the Children's Museum
events.place: Children's Museum of Denver at Marsico Campus, 2121 Children's Museum Dr, Denver
events.source: Days.in.denver November 2026 newsletter (https://days-in-denver.beehiiv.com/p/days-in-denver-november-newsletter); Children's Museum of Denver calendar
events.note: STEAM activities across the museum and $2 off regular admission that day (age 1 $17.75, ages 2–59 $19.75, under 1 free). Tickets are sold at the door, not online.

events.title: TriceraTOTs at Dinosaur Ridge: Dino-Bird in the Hand
events.time: Fri Nov 13 and Sat Nov 14, sessions at 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM (30 min)
events.place: Martin G. Lockley Discovery Center, 17681 W Alameda Pkwy (Red Rocks Entrance #1), Golden
events.source: Days.in.denver November 2026 newsletter; Dinosaur Ridge
events.note: Craft and story time making hand-turkey dinosaurs. Billed as Pre-K (ages 2–5), $5 per participating child, adults free; register online ahead, capped at 20 kids. Held downstairs with no elevator, so carry rather than stroll.

events.title: Denver Christkindlmarket
events.time: Mon–Thu 1–9 PM; Fri–Sun 11 AM–9 PM (daily 11–9 Dec 17–23); Thanksgiving 11 AM–4 PM
events.place: Tivoli Quad, Auraria Campus, 1000 Larimer St, Denver
events.source: Days.in.denver November 2026 newsletter; Auraria Campus announcement
events.note: German-style holiday market with vendors, food, and lawn games. It's on the Auraria Campus this year, not Civic Center Park. Weekend mornings are the easiest with a toddler.

events.title: ice! featuring The Nightmare Before Christmas
events.time: Timed entry daily; buy tickets online in advance
events.place: Gaylord Rockies Resort, 6700 N Gaylord Rockies Blvd, Aurora
events.drive_note: ~43 min from the 64th & Ward base (farther than 30 min)
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Nov 1 post (https://www.instagram.com/p/DfOJ9GLz-s3/); Gaylord Rockies
events.note: Kids 3 and under free with a paid adult. Kept at 9°F (parkas provided); no strollers or wagons inside, so bring a carrier; no restrooms inside. Kids under 4 use the children's slide only. Most visits take 20–40 minutes; arrive on time for your slot.

events.title: Littleton Candlelight Walk
events.place: Main Street, downtown Littleton
events.drive_note: ~33 min from the 64th & Ward base (farther than 30 min)
events.source: Days.in.denver November 2026 newsletter; Visit Littleton
events.note: Friday after Thanksgiving (the newsletter says Saturday, but Visit Littleton lists Fri Nov 27). Holiday parade, tree lighting, drone show, Santa photos, and free hot cocoa and cider. Evening and cold, so bundle up.

events.title: Mile High Drone Shows
events.time: Nightly at 7:00 PM (~10–15 min); check Visit Denver after 4 PM for weather cancels
events.place: Tivoli Quad, Auraria Campus, 1000 Larimer St, Denver (closest viewing)
events.source: Little Rad Adventure IG Nov 4 (https://www.instagram.com/p/DfUtr4Zp_Kf/); Visit Denver Mile High Holidays
events.note: Free nightly holiday drone show (~600 drones). Best family viewing at Tivoli Quad alongside Christkindlmarket and the Mile High Tree; restrooms on campus. Subject to weather cancelation—check the Visit Denver page after 4pm that day.

events.title: Golden Holiday Parade (Western Winter Wonderland)
events.time: 10:30–11:30 AM; free carriage rides noon–2:00 PM after
events.place: Washington Avenue (10th–13th St), downtown Golden
events.source: Little Rad Adventure IG Nov 3 holiday parades (https://www.instagram.com/p/DfSc1HdpUnR/); Visit Golden
events.note: Free daytime parade with floats, marching bands, Victorian carolers, and Santa. Arrive early for parking; organizers ask you to skip chairs and pets. Free carriage rides after on 12th St west of Washington; toy drive drop-off at Parfet Park 11am–4pm.

events.title: Rock and Roll Playhouse: Music of Dolly Parton for Kids
events.place: Bluebird Theater, 3317 E Colfax Ave, Denver
events.source: Colorado Kids Are Rad IG Nov 2 (https://www.instagram.com/p/DfQwVY8RIFN/); Bluebird Theater / AXS
events.note: All-ages family concert (aimed at kids 10 and under) with movement and singing; volume is turned down for little ears. Ticketed via AXS—kids under 1 free, ages 1+ need a ticket; adult must accompany. Short morning show, good toddler length if nap timing works.

events.title: Louisville Parade of Lights
events.time: Santa/performances from ~5:30 PM; parade starts 7:00 PM
events.place: Historic Main Street, Louisville (901 Main St area)
events.source: Little Rad Adventure IG Nov 3 holiday parades (https://www.instagram.com/p/DfSc1HdpUnR/); Louisville Chamber of Commerce
events.note: Free evening lighted parade on Main Street plus Santa visits, performances, and hot chocolate beforehand. Bundle up—it's a 7pm start in December.

events.title: THE POLAR EXPRESS™ Train Ride
events.time: Main shows 5:00, 6:30, or 8:00 PM (arrive ~30 min early for pavilion pre-show); select evenings before Thanksgiving, then daily after
events.place: Colorado Railroad Museum, 17155 W 44th Ave, Golden, CO 80403
events.source: Little Rad Adventure IG Nov 5 (https://www.instagram.com/p/DfXVx5GJB55/); Colorado Railroad Museum; also Destinations with Drew IG Nov 7 (https://www.instagram.com/p/DfdRMn3KVPf/)
events.note: Ticketed evening steam-train + heated pavilion show (hot cocoa, cookies, Silver Bell, Santa). Lap riders under age 2 free; Standard Seating about $80 ages 2–15 / $100 ages 16+ (10% off before Thanksgiving)—sells out yearly. Long multi-part evening for a ~20-month-old; earliest 5pm show is the most realistic if nap timing works. Museum already pinned.

events.title: Santa's Wonderland: free Santa photo at Cabela's Thornton
events.time: Visit times vary by date; reserve up to 7 days ahead, walk-ins as space allows
events.place: Cabela's, 14050 Lincoln St, Thornton, CO 80023
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Nov 6 (https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfa9-Pulkhb/); Bass Pro/Cabela's Oct 26 release
events.note: Free 4×6 studio photo plus a shareable video; kids' crafts. Free Christmas Tales story time with Santa Tuesdays 5pm Nov 10–Dec 22 (separate reservation).

events.title: Winterfest + Santa's arrival at Orchard Town Center
events.time: 3:30–7:30 PM (tree lighting 5:20, free Santa visits from 5:30)
events.place: Orchard Town Center, 14697 Delaware St, Westminster, CO 80023
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Nov 6 (https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfa9-Pulkhb/); Orchard Town Center
events.note: Free, no RSVP. LED Winter Wonderland in the splash pad area, crafts, performances, artisan market; hot cocoa for purchase.

events.title: Nature Playdate at Majestic View
events.place: Majestic View Nature Center, 7030 Garrison St, Arvada, CO 80004
events.source: City of Arvada community calendar (arvadaco.gov), checked 2026-11-09
events.note: Geared toward ages 2–12 and held outdoors; register in advance through CivicRec. Dress warmly.

events.title: Nature Storytime at Majestic View
events.place: Majestic View Nature Center, 7030 Garrison St, Arvada, CO 80004
events.source: City of Arvada community calendar (arvadaco.gov), checked 2026-11-09
events.note: All ages; short 30-minute story time.

events.title: Olde Town Arvada Holiday Tree Lighting
events.place: Olde Town Square, Arvada, CO 80002 (march starts at 7401 Grandview Ave)
events.source: Visit Arvada / Olde Town Arvada (oldetownarvada.org/events), found during the City of Arvada events check
events.note: Free. Live music and Skating in the Square afterward (skating has a fee). Free parking, including the Olde Town parking hub at 5575 Vance St; the G Line also stops here.

events.title: Lakewood Lights
events.place: Heritage Lakewood Belmar Park, 801 S Yarrow St, Lakewood, CO 80226
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Nov 6 (https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfa9-Pulkhb/); City of Lakewood
events.note: Free: tree lighting, carols, light displays, hot cocoa, cookies, ornament crafts and Santa visits. Close to the Lakewood friend.

events.title: Dazzle Kids' Saturday Matinee
events.place: Dazzle @ the Arts Complex, 1080 14th St, Denver, CO 80202
events.source: Days.in.denver IG Nov 9 (https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfh7SXYhIOD/); Dazzle / VenuePilot tickets
events.note: An interactive musical story show at a downtown jazz club, with brunch you can order before or during the show. Nov 14: The Man Who Blamed His Farts on the Animals. Nov 21: Jack and the Beanstalk. Nov 28, Dec 5, and Dec 12: A Christmas Carol. Tickets are $7.45 each including fees, and there's a 2-item food or drink minimum per person. The listed program age is 5–13, so it's a long sit for a 20-month-old. Arrive at 11:30 for a good seat.

events.title: Grand Illumination at Denver Union Station
events.place: Denver Union Station, 1701 Wynkoop St, Denver, CO 80202
events.source: Little Rad Adventure IG Nov 9 tree-lighting list (https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfi2IWZpiM0/); Denver Union Station
events.note: Free. Lighting of the 40-foot tree with 7,000+ lights, the Denver Dolls singing carols, Santa and Mrs. Claus, and live music in the Great Hall. Go early in the 4 PM window for Santa before the crowds.

events.title: Olde Golden Candlelight Walk
events.place: Washington Ave to Parfet Park, Golden, CO 80401
events.source: Little Rad Adventure IG Nov 9 tree-lighting list (https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfi2IWZpiM0/); Visit Golden
events.note: Free. A caroling candle walk down Washington Ave, then Santa switches on 45,000 lights. Golden History Park adds a luminaria walk, a bonfire, and free cocoa. Use a battery candle with a toddler. A free shuttle runs from the Splash Lot (3151 Illinois St) 5–9 PM.

events.title: Broomfield Holiday Tree Lighting Ceremony
events.place: George Di Ciero City and County Building, 1 DesCombes Dr, Broomfield, CO 80020
events.source: Little Rad Adventure IG Nov 9 tree-lighting list (https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfi2IWZpiM0/); City and County of Broomfield
events.note: Free. School choirs, the mayor lights the tree, Santa, holiday wagon rides, food trucks, and cookies. It's the same night as Golden's Candlelight Walk, so pick one.

events.title: Sheridan Green Park Grand Opening
events.place: Sheridan Green Park, 10951 Harlan St, Westminster, CO 80020
events.source: Colorado Kids Are Rad IG Nov 13 (https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfr3-2qxyue/); City of Westminster events page
events.note: Free. First look at the new swamp-themed playground (gator, climbing cattails, swings), with free gumbo and beignets while supplies last. Starts after his ~2pm nap wake-up.

events.title: Blossoms of Light at Denver Botanic Gardens
events.place: Denver Botanic Gardens, 1007 York St, Denver, CO 80206
events.source: Little Rad Adventure IG Nov 11 (https://www.instagram.com/p/DfoIHL9u86L/); botanicgardens.org
events.note: Timed tickets bought ahead on the Gardens' site only, $19–$45 by date (cheapest on late-Nov/early-Jan weeknights); kids 2 and under free. Sensory-Friendly Night Tue Dec 1, 5–8 PM. Mordecai Children's Garden is closed during the event. Dress warm; plan ~60–75 min loop.

events.title: Disney On Ice: Find Your Hero
events.time: Fri 7 PM; Sat 11 AM, 3 PM, 7 PM; Sun 10:30 AM, 2:30 PM
events.place: Ball Arena, 1000 Chopper Circle, Denver, CO 80204
events.source: Colorado Mama Life IG Nov 12 weekend list (https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfp25Q5T4wP/); Ball Arena; disneyonice.com
events.note: Ticketed via Ticketmaster. Ages 2 and up need a ticket. The Sun 10:30 AM show fits before nap; a long arena show for a 20-month-old, so aisle seats help.

events.title: Mile High Tree Lighting Ceremony
events.time: 5:30 PM lighting; the tree's light shows run every 15 min, 5–10 PM nightly through Dec 31
events.place: Tivoli Quad, Auraria Campus, 1000 Larimer St, Denver, CO 80204
events.source: Days.in.denver IG Nov 15 (https://www.instagram.com/p/DfxTH65hhd0/); Visit Denver Mile High Holidays
events.note: Free. It's the same night Christkindlmarket opens and the first 7 PM drone show, all on the Tivoli Quad. The 110-ft tree holds up to 140 people inside for the light shows. Paid parking on campus. If you miss the 5:30 lighting, the tree runs light shows nightly through Dec 31, so an earlier evening visit is easier with a toddler.
